_about: Feat loop, batch 2, lane b2-attack-a (2026-11-22): the second half of the audit's
'attack-shape / other combat' sort, most of which are passive or situational, built as
each Benefit says (content/feats/feats.json, checked against aonprd.com FeatDisplay).
The feats a character USES (Sociable's move action, Punishing Kick's declared blow) are
documents in content/class-abilities/feats-b2-attack-a.json, run by the class-ability
executor; their entry here is empty, or carries the `not_yet` that keeps them PARTIAL.
New readers this lane built: the swing's moment (`opportunity`, `first_attack`:
a target `aloft` (sheet.aloft), a ranged weapon's threat (reactions.ranged_threat), an
extra attack of opportunity while wielding (reactions.extra_while_wielding).

not_yet: 'a weapon or shield with a polished or reflective surface': gear records no finish, so a bare-handed user is not refused
'unable to use its mouth to attack, speak clearly, and employ verbal spell components' until the bleed ends: nothing asks for a working mouth

modifiers.note: against attacks of opportunity from opponents not adjacent to you
an attack of opportunity against a flying opponent
a weapon set against a flying opponent's charge (a readied attack, rules/readied.py)
an attack of opportunity with a ranged weapon that hits
Power Attack's penalty lifted from the first attack each turn, two-handed
Improvisation's +2 on skills you have no ranks in raised to +4
two more unarmed strikes at your highest bonus, against a dazed, flat-footed, paralyzed, staggered, stunned or unconscious foe

not_yet: the bull rush in place of the trip ('push your opponent back as if from the bull rush combat maneuver ... you cannot move with the target'): the engine always takes the trip
'move up to half your speed instead of taking a 5-foot step when taking a full-round action to perform a coup de grace': the coup still spends the move (Scene.move_spent), so no move follows it

modifiers.note: CRB: 'Whenever you move, you may move through 5 feet of difficult terrain each round as if it were normal terrain. The effects of this feat allow you to take a 5-foot step into difficult terrain.' Per round (feat_moves._spend_easy; stacks with Acrobatic Steps for 20, feat loop b5-other), and the step (rules/stepping.py, feat loop b5-core)

not_yet: moving after a mounted charge in the same line, and no attack of opportunity from the foe charged: the charge is lane b2-actions' machinery
catching the deflected missile and throwing a thrown weapon back at once: Deflect Arrows turns the shot aside, and no reader catches it into a free hand
two hero points a level instead of one: the app keeps no hero points (APG optional system)
a free 5-foot step between Cleave's attacks that brings a new foe into reach: Cleave's extra blows are chosen from those threatened when it is declared

modifiers.note: on Goblin Cleaver's additional attacks against humanoids (giant)
on Goblin Cleaver's additional attacks against humanoids (orc)

not_yet: Archon Style's lowered penalty, move-action use and the diverted blow: Archon Style is lane b2-styles'
a grapple without provoking against a foe held by Beartrap Bite (lane b2-attack-b's feat), and +2 damage against a foe you grapple: no grapple-damage term asks who holds whom yet
a swift action after 10 damage to a prone foe with a natural weapon or unarmed strike: Fortitude or a bestow curse disfigurement — the swift budget (lane b2-actions) and Wolf Style (lane b2-styles)
moving at half speed while prone, and a 5-foot step while crawling: no move asks whether the mover is prone, so a crawl is not priced or allowed by rule
a dodge bonus to AC against the feinted foe equal to your weapon training bonus, in place of denying his Dexterity: nothing reads the weapon training bonus for the weapon in hand by itself
ending an ongoing figment to strike a foe in or beside it for 1d6 per spell level: figments are not run as standing illusions
a free action giving an adjacent ally with the feat half your armour bonus as circumstance AC for a round while you lose it
a free-action aid another on an ally's trained Knowledge check within 30 feet, sharing what it learns
a standard-action Spellcraft check (DC 10 + spell level) to swap an ongoing abjuration or transmutation's chosen option at half its remaining duration
+1 caster level when beating a Use Magic Device DC by 5 on a spell completion or trigger item, +2 for an extra charge by 10: Use Magic Device has no activation door yet
a move-action feint after a melee hit that opens the foe to an adjacent ally with the feat, +2/+4 in bright light or sunlight
a second attack at -5 on a foe beside the first after a Ride-By Attack hit: Ride-By Attack is not built (the charge, lane b2-actions)
+1 dodge against attacks of opportunity from a larger creature while an ally with the feat is in its reach, and its misses provoking from those allies
a free action after a hit granting the foe +2 attack and damage against you, its attack then provoking from allies with the feat
mounts sharing squares and charging through allied mounts: no mounted combat on the board yet
damage reduction applied once to the total of a full attack's ranged hits on one foe: each hit meets the reduction alone
handing the feinted foe a held one-handed object in place of denying its Dexterity
a full attack split by abundant step or dimension door teleports between the attacks (Dimensional Assault is lane b2-attack-b's)
a standard-action Bluff against every foe threatening you, then a move at speed that provokes none of those fooled
the 5-foot or full-speed move before a performance combat check, +2 to it: performance combat (Ultimate Combat optional system) is not built
tripping or disarming with a net in melee (+2 on the disarm), and dragging or repositioning a foe the net entangles
a foe you threaten taking a 5-foot step or withdrawing provokes from you; a hit stops the move and deals no damage — attacks of opportunity on a step are lane b2-actions'
while raging: two-handed weapons thrown as a standard action, thrown range increments doubled, improvised objects picked up as part of the throw
a swift action after an unarmed hit to deliver a chosen one-target arcane school power: the swift budget is lane b2-actions', and school powers are not aimed through a blow
an earth breaker one-handed beside a skull shield that keeps its shield bonus and counts as light for two-weapon penalties
